sources.entry: Build A Simple Search Bot in 30 minutes

summary.title: How to Build A Simple Search Bot in 30 Minutes
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a small Node.js bot that watches Kijiji apartment listings for changes by hashing the scraped ad IDs, then sends an SMS alert through Twilio.
keywords: send sms text alert from script
how do i get text alerts when a listing changes
takeaways: Fetch a page with request-promise and inspect the markup to find stable CSS classes and data attributes.
Hashing the full HTML fails because of timestamps and rotating ads, so hash only the extracted listing IDs instead.
Use Cheerio to parse HTML and select elements such as .search-item.regular-ad, reading attributes via element.attribs.
Send an SMS alert with Twilio's JavaScript API when the hash of listing IDs changes.
summary.summary: The author, a Montreal renter, describes building a lightweight Node.js script that polls a Kijiji search page and detects new or removed ads. The tutorial walks through fetching HTML, hashing it with the checksum package (which failed because of timestamps and dynamic content), then parsing with Cheerio and hashing only the ad IDs. Finally it adds a Twilio-based SMS function to text the user when a change is detected. The article also links an open source Kijiji scraper repo on GitHub.
